svg.text: Mencius Protocol 𝒫 — Rule-2 / Rule-3 safety bug
Canonical 3-server, no-crash Lamport diagram of the scenario in bug.md. Source: Mencius_bugged.spur.

g.text: All inter-node RPCs over per-pair FifoLink<Node>.

svg.text: Phase B — Two broadcasts race on independent FIFO links
Phase C — Handler effects (FIFO ordering breaks symmetrically across the pair)
Phase D — Ballot-0 quorum at {p0, p2} chooses v

g.text: p2 · HandleAccept tally for slot 2 ballot (0,2)
self ⑫ + p0 ⑨ → count = 2 ≥ majority(2)

svg.text: LEARN(slot=2, v) ← will be discarded by p1 (see Phase G)
Phase E — Second client write at p2 (the trigger for fill_q_skips)
Phase F — The bug fires on p1

g.text: Critical race: on the p2 → p1 FIFO link, ⑮ (LEARN(2,v)) was enqueued
BEFORE ⑲ (PROPOSE(5,…)) — but ⑲'s HandlePropose task is dispatched
and runs to on_suggestion before HandleLearn flips learned_flags[2].
learn_slot(2, nil) ← p1 commits slot 2 = no-op
est_index[2] = 8; also learn_slot(1, nil), learn_slot(4, nil);

svg.text: Phase G — Masked LEARN and revoke that can no longer repair the divergence
⑮' LEARN(2, v) delivered at p1 — is_learned(2)==T → ✗ discarded (line 679)

g.text: ACKs ⑪ + ⑩ + ⑬ → majority. Best accept: (0,2)/v

svg.text: Phase H — The violation becomes observable

g.text: A subsequent ClientWrite at p0 (or flushed need_to_skip) fills slot 0/3,
advancing every node's `expected` past slot 2 so kv_store reflects it.
Root cause: fill_q_skips on ⑲ unilaterally learned slot 2 = no-op
on p1 even though {p0, p2} had already committed slot 2 = v at ballot 0.
Classification: paper bug. See bug.md §"The fix" for the safety guard.
